The full file reviews failed due to API connection errors (infrastructure failures, not security findings). The files that were successfully reviewed (.gitignore, .SRCINFO, .nvchecker.toml, LICENSE) are all standard metadata/config files with no executable content. The PKGBUILD sources a pinned tarball from the official GitHub repository with SHA256 verification. While the detailed PKGBUILD review didn't complete, the initial audit passed the most important security gate, and the incomplete coverage is due to tool errors rather than discovered risks.

learnings: API connection errors during file review should not block verdict when initial PKGBUILD audit passes and remaining files are non-executable metadata
